comment: The class of each tool of hyper (S1): ecosystem names the tool it uses, policy the reason no ecosystem tool applies. The tools below scripts/kit are copies of kit and are classed in kit.

scripts/board-servers.mts.tool: node:child_process starts the servers of a run and node:fs and node:os give each run its temporary directory (HR-87, HR-89)

scripts/build-template-ext.mts.tool: phpize, configure and make build the native template extension from the php-ext archive of the template release

scripts/build-templates.mts.tool: @polyspec/template parses the templates, through writeTemplateFiles of packages/build/lib/template-files.mjs

scripts/check-bundle-size.mts.tool: node:zlib measures the gzip and brotli sizes against the limits of config/bundle-size.json

scripts/check-parity.mts.reason: proves that the browser code and the PHP, Node and Python servers render the same bytes for the requests of one file (HY-12, HY-13, HR-55); no ecosystem tool compares the renderings of this protocol; esbuild bundles the browser code and @polyspec/template renders

scripts/check-templates.mts.reason: the template rules of hyper (HC-6, HY-3, HY-30, HY-75) in packages/build/lib/template-rules.mjs; @polyspec/template parses the templates

scripts/json.mts.reason: polyspec's rule that code reads a JSON value with what it expects and a failure that names its place, instead of asserting the type away (K157)

scripts/line-end.mts.reason: HR-84: a log line never joins the next line; the script ends each stream of a command that left no final newline, which no ecosystem tool does

scripts/publish.mts.tool: node:fs renames, through publish of packages/build/lib/publish.mjs (HR-82)

scripts/run-e2e.mts.tool: Playwright runs the browser tests on the servers that scripts/board-servers.mts starts (HR-87)

scripts/serve-demo.mts.reason: the interactive demo of the board example in both rendering modes on fixed ports, held by the holder-lock of @polyspec/kit so that it exists once; no ecosystem tool starts the servers of this repository

scripts/serve-edge.mts.reason: the local counterpart of the CDN in front of the client-side rendering deployment: the API prefix goes to the API origin, /compare returns the comparison page, a file of the deployment is returned and every other path returns index.html; it runs on node:http

scripts/tracked-files.mts.tool: git ls-files lists the tracked files of a path; the copy keeps their modification time and executable bits through packages/build/lib/output-files.mjs

packages/build/bin/hyper-build-assets.mj.tool: esbuild bundles the client, @tailwindcss/node and @tailwindcss/oxide build the stylesheet, and @polyspec/template parses the templates

packages/build/bin/hyper-build-server.mj.tool: @polyspec/template-compiler compiles the templates into the PHP program and the type manifest

packages/build/lib/output-files.mjs.tool: node:fs writes and copies the files, and sets the modes 0644 and 0755 that HR-68 requires whatever the umask

packages/build/lib/publish.mjs.tool: node:fs rename(2) moves each staged file into its target (HR-82)

packages/build/lib/template-files.mjs.tool: node:crypto hashes the template files and @polyspec/template parses them

packages/build/lib/template-rules.mjs.reason: the template rules of hyper (HC-6, HY-3, HY-30, HY-75) over the AST that @polyspec/template parses; no ecosystem tool states the rules of this protocol
